hook: Zero to 650 mph in five seconds. Then only two parachutes opened.
narration: Zero to six hundred fifty miles an hour, in five seconds.
This was Boeing's Starliner, in a pad abort test at White Sands, New Mexico.
[short pause] Then only two of its three main parachutes opened.
Engineers build in backups. Two good chutes still meant a stable ride down.
Next it dropped its heat shield, and airbags inflated underneath.
outcome: Starliner touched down safely on the desert floor, riding on two parachutes.

description:
Boeing's CST-100 Starliner fired its launch abort engines in a pad abort test at Launch Complex 32, White Sands Missile Range, New Mexico, on Nov. 4, 2019. Two of its three main parachutes opened and it touched down safely on the desert floor.
